sn35.60:1.4: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.60:1.6: Evampassaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati || rūpesu pi nibbindati || cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati || cakkhusamphasse pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi nibbindati || ||
sn35.60:1.7: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimokkhā pariññātam me upādānanti pajānāti || || 5-8
sn35.60:1.8: Sotaṃ ca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati ||
sn35.60:1.9: Ghānaṃ ca paṭicca gandheca || Jivhaṃ ca
sn35.60:1.12: Manam ca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.60:1.14: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako manasmim pi nibbindati || dhammesu pi nibbindati || manoviññāṇe pi nibbindati || manosamphasse pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi nibbindati || ||
